name: 女の子（基本）ジェスチャー
author: kaede

source.prompt: Phase 5 ①c gesture sheet for the girl (composed by scripts/factory/compose_gesture_sheet.py, 2026-08-12 — the boy sheet's 12-cell layout, avatar.boy-basic-gestures precedent). Sources: sit/sleep/wave = nano-banana-2 reference+instruction pose edits of the committed avatar-girl stand cell on the 720px green canvas (character ~470px tall), generated via Cloudflare AI Gateway (kaede-assets, ~$0.10/still): sit = cross-legged floor sit directly ON the ground line, legs folded in front, hands on knees, back upright (the 2026-08-10 candidate-D cross-legged one-shot precedent held — no wan-i2v fallback needed); sleep = lies asleep on her side, head right, eyes closed, one arm folded, knees slightly bent (take 2 of 3 adopted: take 1 drew a literal ground line under her, take 3 oversized the character past the hair-scale gate at ratio 1.158); wave = near arm raised high, elbow bent, open palm waving, far arm relaxed (one-shot; same raised-far-arm read as the committed boy wave). dance-a..h = 0-based frames 0/74/9/48/18/22/26/31 of the REGISTERED gangnam/girl master take (master_takes.json master 9649b9d2…, 496×496 79 frames — owner-approved by the PR #104 merge; cut directly from the master, no replace call, no charge): 8 phase-even slots over the 35-frame loop from the registered start 0, each slot's frame picked blink-aware from its phase-equivalent candidates (blink.py — zero residual suspects; loop re-verified on the extracted frames at loop-mean 0.970 / closure 0.982 = the ledger values), 100ms per sampled cell = DANCE_FRAME_MS. Scale normalization back to the 720 canvas: nano stills x720/1024, master cells by the median hair-blob ratio against the stand (the master's own canvas scale is not the bench canvas's — the replace lane's rule), every cell re-verified by hair-blob area against the stand (fail loud). Neck anchors are hair-blob estimates persisted as neckAnchors overrides — the structural neck detector breaks on arms-over-head dance frames and the lying sleeper (boy-precedent measurements); the sleep anchor is approximate by design (nothing renders from it: the busy headgear overlay hides on sleep). NO head composite anywhere: dance frames keep the master's video-native heads (erase-then-paste erases arms crossing above the neck line — boy-precedent measurement), the nano stills keep their own redrawn heads, all gated by the calibrated per-cell palette-drift check. The sheet is committed factory-ready but UNCONSUMED, like the avatar-girl walk cells: wiring the girl skin into AvatarView is 増分①d (setSkin).
